name: p6-seat-cap
title: Per-user seat cap
kind: feature with a concurrency and permission trap
tests: Carrying the context that makes the naive implementation wrong (thread pool, 20 parallel requests, store interface frozen) plus a permission rule (admins exempt from the cap, not from capacity).
left_open: Which error is raised when a request is over both the cap and the capacity (not tested)
Whether admin-held seats count toward anything (not tested)
inferred: cancel() must not lose updates when it runs in parallel with other calls
The cap is counted from stored reservations, so it holds across service objects
